none: PAS LIN-4A2603: Roman copper alloy TOT ring
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper-alloy TOT ring, Henig type XI. The bezel is rectangular and bears the letters TOT, which is an abbreviation of the Celtic god-name Toutatis or Totatis. The inscription is set within a border of opposed punched chevrons. This ring is number 94 in Daubney's catalogue
